display.purpose: The homepage headline only: unpressed keys on the first line, the answer on the second. French min(100px, 6.9vw); under 650px min(15vw, 64px) at -0.04em.

headline.purpose: The h1 of Read pages (privacy, support).

title.purpose: Section h2s on the homepage; 26px (24px mobile) inside Read-page articles.

statement.purpose: Short declarative lines of the 'never' list, each above a muted paragraph.

subtitle.purpose: h3s and the contact card's heading.

lead.purpose: Moss Grey paragraph under a headline or section title, max 65ch; 18px under 650px.

body.purpose: All reading text; 62ch in descriptive lists, 720px measure on Read pages.

label.purpose: Buttons, the switch, the text button, the live count.

meta.purpose: Captions, store status, update date, policy index, readout status. Footer runs 13px/1.65; readout details 12.5px.

data.purpose: The register, in tabular numerals; column heads 700 at 13px.

popup-host.purpose: The site's hostname in the popup, one line with an ellipsis; 18px Folder Grey for 'Not a web page'.

popup-state.purpose: The sentence heading the change list.

popup-body.purpose: Switch-row and segment labels (segments 500, 600 when selected).

popup-button.purpose: Zap now and Undo on this page.

popup-small.purpose: Mode hint, notes, change reasons (two lines max) and the debug row.

popup-kind.purpose: Uppercase kind column of the change list.

popup-time.purpose: Change times in tabular numerals; row numbers at 11px italic.

popup-selector.purpose: The changed element's selector; the only monospace in the popup.

popup-count.purpose: Tacet Figures (Bravura's time-signature digits, SIL OFL 1.1) for the count above the rest, and nothing else. Bundled; font-display: block.

shadows.name: drawn-outline
shadows.purpose: The only box-shadow in the system: an ink outline on the secondary button and the switch track. A line, not elevation; the site casts no shadows.

shadows.name: popup-drawn-bar
shadows.purpose: Popup only: draws the rest's bar as an outline while Tacet watches (lime) or is off (Rest Grey). A line, not elevation.

motion.name: wash
motion.purpose: The one motion grammar: a status changes in place (new readout entries, register rows turning). Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The single easing curve, shared by the wash and the switch thumb.

motion.name: switch-thumb
motion.purpose: The switch knob slides 30px between off and on; the only movement besides the wash. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: switch-colour
motion.purpose: Track and thumb colour change on the switch. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: register-stagger
motion.purpose: Delay between register rows that enter view together (IntersectionObserver threshold 0.9).

motion.name: readout-settle
motion.purpose: After the last change arrives, the readout's status sentence is rewritten to summarise what Tacet did.

motion.name: anchor-scroll
motion.purpose: In-page anchors, inherited from the family. Auto under reduced motion.

motion.name: popup-ease
motion.purpose: Popup only: switch thumbs (18px slide), switch track colours and the selected segment's slide; also segment label colour, button fill and border, and the rest bar's colour. Every transition off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: popup-more-below
motion.purpose: Popup change list: static fade on the last 32px while more rows remain below; removed at the end of the scroll. Not animated.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The install action: ink fill, paper text, 8px corners, olive on hover. Always paired with the secondary button and a muted status line.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 8px; font: 650 15px/1.7 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; background: var(--ink, #20231d); color: var(--paper, #f6f5ef); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--green, #526600); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--ink, #20231d); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green, #526600); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The second install action: transparent with a 1.5px inset ink outline (a drawn line, not elevation), tint on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 8px; font: 650 15px/1.7 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #20231d); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ink, #20231d); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--tint, #e8eddb); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green, #526600); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Brand mark and wordmark on the left; muted 14px links with a 2px olive underline for the current page; the language switch set off by a hairline divider.
components.html:
Tacet
OverviewPrivacySupportFrançais
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px 24px; padding: 18px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d5d8ca); background: var(--paper, #f6f5ef); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; color: var(--ink, #20231d); font-size: 23px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -0.03em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--muted, #5c6353); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink, #20231d); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--green, #526600); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 7px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green, #526600); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-nav .ds-lang { padding-left: 24px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #d5d8ca); }

components.name: Unpressed Keys and the Answer
components.description: Signature. The site's two consent buttons set inside the h1 as inert dashed keys, then the answer in ink with a lime highlighter under its last words. Shown at the mobile size (64px, 2px dashes); desktop is min(116px, 8vw) with 3px dashes. Keys never take hover, cursor or focus.
components.html: Accept all, or Refuse?Tacet presses neither.
components.css: .ds-question { margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #20231d); font: 750 64px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-wrap: pretty; } .ds-unpressed { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.24em; margin-bottom: 0.24em; } .ds-key { padding: 0.05em 0.38em 0.13em; border: 2px dashed var(--unpressed-line, #b9bdaa); border-radius: 0.17em; color: var(--unpressed, #868b73); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-answer { display: block; } .ds-answer mark { background: none; color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--lime, #d5ed75); text-decoration-thickness: 0.3em; text-underline-offset: -0.2em; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; } .ds-vh { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Tacet Switch
components.description: Signature interaction. A role=switch button: label, pill track, state word. Off is a paper track with an ink outline and ink thumb; on is an ink track with a lime thumb. The olive live count sits beside it in tabular numerals. Both states shown.
components.html: 3 changes
components.css: .ds-switch-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 24px; background: var(--paper, #f6f5ef); } .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink, #20231d); font: 650 15px/1.7 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch .ds-track { position: relative; width: 64px; height: 34px; border-radius: 17px; background: var(--paper, #f6f5ef); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ink, #20231d); transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-switch .ds-track::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 5px; left: 5px; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink, #20231d); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] .ds-track { background: var(--ink, #20231d); } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] .ds-track::after { transform: translateX(30px); background: var(--lime, #d5ed75); } .ds-switch .ds-state { min-width: 2.2em; } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green, #526600); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-live-count { color: var(--green, #526600); font: 650 15px/1.7 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-switch .ds-track, .ds-switch .ds-track::after { transition: none; } }

components.name: Readout
components.description: Signature. Tacet's voice in the demo: an ink panel that states what Tacet did, one hairline-ruled entry per change, lime verb, paper subject, muted detail with tabular timing. New entries arrive under the lime wash.
components.html:
Tacet3 changes

Tacet hid the made-up consent wall, unlocked scrolling and cleared the blur. Switch it off to put everything back.

  1. HiddenThe made-up consent wallrecognised by cookies, consent, partners · 0.31 s after Tacet started
  2. UnlockedPage scrollingoverflow · 0.31 s after Tacet started
  3. RepairedThe blurred article0.31 s after Tacet started
components.css: .ds-readout { width: 340px; max-width: 100%; padding: 18px 20px 8px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--ink, #20231d); color: var(--paper, #f6f5ef); font: 400 17px/1.7 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-readout-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-readout-top span { color: var(--lime, #d5ed75); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-readout p { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--ink-muted, #b4b9a6); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-readout ol { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-readout li { padding: 10px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink-line, #3a3e35); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-readout li b { margin-right: 6px; color: var(--lime, #d5ed75); font-weight: 700; } .ds-readout li small { display: block; color: var(--ink-muted, #b4b9a6); font-size: 12.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-readout li.ds-fresh { animation: ds-wash 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @keyframes ds-wash { from { background-color: rgb(213 237 117 / 22%); } to { background-color: transparent; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-readout li.ds-fresh { animation: none; } }

components.name: Register
components.description: Signature. A ruled table that never moves: 1.5px ink rule under 13px column heads, 1px hairlines between rows, tabular times right-aligned. Rows turn from 'Wall up' to the result in place under the wash; a text button reveals the full list.
components.html:
Time: seconds from the start of the page until Tacet hid the wall.
SitePageConsent toolWhat Tacet didHidden at
20 MinutesArticleDidomiHid the wall, unlocked scrolling0.27 s
BBC AfriqueArticleSourcepointHid the wall0.34 s
ChallengesHome pageDidomiHid the wall, unlocked scrolling0.03 s
components.css: .ds-register-wrap { overflow-x: auto; background: var(--paper, #f6f5ef); color: var(--ink, #20231d); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-register { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.45; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-register caption { padding-bottom: 12px; color: var(--muted, #5c6353); font-size: 14px; text-align: left; } .ds-register th { padding: 10px 16px 10px 0; border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #20231d); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-register td { padding: 11px 16px 11px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d5d8ca); vertical-align: top; } .ds-register td:first-child { font-weight: 650; } .ds-register .ds-did { color: var(--muted, #5c6353); } .ds-register .ds-num { padding-right: 0; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-register tr.ds-turned td { animation: ds-wash 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @keyframes ds-wash { from { background-color: rgb(213 237 117 / 22%); } to { background-color: transparent; } } .ds-text-button { min-height: 44px; margin-top: 12px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--green, #526600); font: 650 15px/1.7 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-button:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-text-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green, #526600); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-register tr.ds-turned td { animation: none; } }

components.name: Ink Panel
components.description: Where Tacet states its promise: ink ground, lime heading and link, paper body in a 1 : 1.4 grid. Stacks under 650px.
components.html:
Nothing leaves
your browser.

Tacet has no server, no analytics and no account. It asks for a single permission, storage.

It reads each page only to find walls, and sends nothing anywhere. Read exactly what it reads and keeps
components.css: .ds-ink-panel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr; gap: 40px; padding: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--ink, #20231d); color: var(--paper, #f6f5ef); font: 400 17px/1.7 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-ink-panel h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--lime, #d5ed75); font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 36px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.03em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-ink-panel p { margin: 0 0 20px; } .ds-ink-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; } .ds-ink-panel a { color: var(--lime, #d5ed75); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-ink-panel a:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-ink-panel a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--lime, #d5ed75); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; } @media (max-width: 650px) { .ds-ink-panel { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 20px; padding: 28px 24px; } }

components.name: Tint Card
components.description: The one quiet aside (support's 'Report a problem'): pale sage tint, 12px corners, no border or shadow, olive body link.
components.html:
Report a problem

Open an issue on GitHub with the page address and what you see. Issues are public: do not include personal information.
components.css: .ds-tint-card { padding: 24px 28px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--tint, #e8eddb); color: var(--ink, #20231d); font: 400 17px/1.7 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-tint-card h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-tint-card p { margin: 0; } .ds-tint-card a { color: var(--green, #526600); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-tint-card a:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-tint-card a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green, #526600); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Disclosure List
components.description: Support's quick checks: hairline-separated details, 650 summaries with a drawn chevron that flips open, muted answers; olive on hover.
components.html:
A wall is still on the page

Open Tacet’s popup from the toolbar and press Zap now: it hides whatever still covers the page and unlocks scrolling.

Something I opened disappeared

Press Undo on this page in the popup, or switch Tacet off for the site, then report the page.
components.css: .ds-disclosures { background: var(--paper, #f6f5ef); color: var(--ink, #20231d); font: 400 17px/1.7 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-disclosures details { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #d5d8ca); } .ds-disclosures details:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d5d8ca); } .ds-disclosures summary { position: relative; padding: 20px 28px 20px 0; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-disclosures summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-disclosures summary::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 27px; right: 4px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-right: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-disclosures details[open] summary::after { top: 31px; transform: rotate(225deg); } .ds-disclosures summary:hover { color: var(--green, #526600); } .ds-disclosures summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green, #526600); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-disclosures p { margin: 0 0 24px; padding-right: 28px; color: var(--muted, #5c6353); }

components.name: Popup Rest
components.description: Popup signature. The count of what Tacet silenced as a multi-measure rest: acted (solid lime, figure), watching (lime outline), off (Rest Grey outline). The real figure uses the bundled Tacet Figures font; system numerals stand in here.
components.html: 3
components.css: :host, .ds-popup { --folder: #141513; --raised: #1d1e1b; --selected: #33352f; --engraving: #ecebe5; --lime: #d5ed75; --grey: #8f9288; --mark: #7d8076; --rule: #262824; --edge: #3d3f39; } .ds-popup { width: 340px; padding: 14px 16px 12px; background: var(--folder); color: var(--engraving); font: 13px/1.35 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-rest-row { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-rest { position: relative; width: 64px; height: 48px; color: var(--lime); } .ds-rest::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 10px; height: 1px; background: var(--edge); } .ds-bar { position: absolute; inset: auto 8px 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 1px; background: currentColor; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-bar::before, .ds-bar::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -4px; width: 3px; height: 15px; border-radius: 1px; background: currentColor; } .ds-bar::before { left: -2px; } .ds-bar::after { right: -2px; } .ds-figure { position: absolute; inset: 16px 0 auto; height: 0; color: var(--engraving); font: 56px/0 "Tacet Figures", Georgia, serif; text-align: center; } .ds-rest[data-state="watching"] .ds-bar, .ds-rest[data-state="off"] .ds-bar { background: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px currentColor; } .ds-rest[data-state="off"] { color: var(--mark); }

components.name: Popup Segmented Control
components.description: Where Tacet runs: three radios drawn as a segmented control whose Selected Folder block slides under the checked label over 180ms ease-out.
components.html:
Where Tacet runs

Runs only on the sites you switch on.
components.css: :host, .ds-popup { --folder: #141513; --raised: #1d1e1b; --selected: #33352f; --engraving: #ecebe5; --lime: #d5ed75; --grey: #8f9288; --mark: #7d8076; --rule: #262824; --edge: #3d3f39; } .ds-popup { width: 340px; padding: 14px 16px 12px; background: var(--folder); color: var(--engraving); font: 13px/1.35 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-modes { margin: 0; border: 0; } .ds-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); } .ds-segments { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); height: 34px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--raised); } .ds-segments::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 3px auto 3px 3px; width: calc((100% - 6px) / 3); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--selected); transition: transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-segments:has([value="on"]:checked)::before { transform: translateX(100%); } .ds-segments:has([value="off"]:checked)::before { transform: translateX(200%); } .ds-segments label { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--grey); font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-segments label:hover { color: var(--engraving); } .ds-segments label:has(:checked) { color: var(--engraving); font-weight: 600; } .ds-segments label:has(:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-segments input { position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-hint { margin: 7px 0 0; color: var(--grey); font-size: 12px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-segments::before, .ds-segments label { transition: none; } }

components.name: Popup Switch Rows
components.description: Label left, switch right, the whole 44px row toggles it; hairline between rows. Off: Folder Edge track, grey thumb. On: lime track, folder-black thumb.
components.css: :host, .ds-popup { --folder: #141513; --raised: #1d1e1b; --selected: #33352f; --engraving: #ecebe5; --lime: #d5ed75; --grey: #8f9288; --mark: #7d8076; --rule: #262824; --edge: #3d3f39; } .ds-popup { width: 340px; padding: 14px 16px 12px; background: var(--folder); color: var(--engraving); font: 13px/1.35 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-switch { position: relative; flex: none; width: 44px; height: 26px; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--edge); transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--grey); pointer-events: none; transition: transform 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-switch:has(:checked) { background: var(--lime); } .ds-switch:has(:checked)::after { background: var(--folder); transform: translateX(18px); } .ds-switch:has(:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: inherit; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-switch, .ds-switch::after { transition: none; } }

components.name: Popup Primary Button
components.description: Zap now: engraving-white fill, folder-black text, 8px corners, 34px tall; white on hover.
components.css: :host, .ds-popup { --folder: #141513; --raised: #1d1e1b; --selected: #33352f; --engraving: #ecebe5; --lime: #d5ed75; --grey: #8f9288; --mark: #7d8076; --rule: #262824; --edge: #3d3f39; } .ds-popup { width: 340px; padding: 14px 16px 12px; background: var(--folder); color: var(--engraving); font: 13px/1.35 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-pbtn { width: 100%; height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--engraving); font: 600 13px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-pbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pbtn-primary { border-color: var(--engraving); background: var(--engraving); color: var(--folder); } .ds-pbtn-primary:hover { border-color: #ffffff; background: #ffffff; } .ds-pbtn-primary:active { background: #d9d8d1; }

components.name: Popup Secondary Button
components.description: Undo on this page: transparent with a 1px Folder Edge border; Raised Folder on hover, Selected Folder on press; Rest Grey text when disabled.
components.css: :host, .ds-popup { --folder: #141513; --raised: #1d1e1b; --selected: #33352f; --engraving: #ecebe5; --lime: #d5ed75; --grey: #8f9288; --mark: #7d8076; --rule: #262824; --edge: #3d3f39; } .ds-popup { width: 340px; padding: 14px 16px 12px; background: var(--folder); color: var(--engraving); font: 13px/1.35 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-pbtn { flex: 1; height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--engraving); font: 600 13px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-pbtn:hover { border-color: var(--grey); background: var(--raised); } .ds-pbtn:active { background: var(--selected); } .ds-pbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pbtn:disabled, .ds-pbtn:disabled:hover { border-color: var(--rule); background: transparent; color: var(--mark); cursor: default; }

components.css: :host, .ds-popup { --folder: #141513; --raised: #1d1e1b; --selected: #33352f; --engraving: #ecebe5; --lime: #d5ed75; --grey: #8f9288; --mark: #7d8076; --rule: #262824; --edge: #3d3f39; } .ds-popup { width: 340px; padding: 14px 16px 12px; background: var(--folder); color: var(--engraving); font: 13px/1.35 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-state { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-list { max-height: 120px; margin: 4px 0 0; padding: 0; overflow-y: auto; list-style: none; scrollbar-color: var(--mark) transparent; scrollbar-width: thin; } .ds-list[data-more] { mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000 calc(100% - 32px), transparent); } .ds-list li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 14px 58px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; column-gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; padding: 9px 0 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-no { color: var(--grey); font-size: 11px; font-style: italic; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kind { color: var(--grey); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-list code { overflow: hidden; font: 12px/1.35 ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-time { color: var(--grey); font-size: 11.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; } .ds-why { grid-column: 3 / 5; color: var(--grey); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Popup Final Bar and Debug Row
components.description: The popup closes on a final double bar (1px over 3px, Rest Grey), with the quiet debug switch row under it in 12px Folder Grey.
components.css: :host, .ds-popup { --folder: #141513; --raised: #1d1e1b; --selected: #33352f; --engraving: #ecebe5; --lime: #d5ed75; --grey: #8f9288; --mark: #7d8076; --rule: #262824; --edge: #3d3f39; } .ds-popup { width: 340px; padding: 14px 16px 12px; background: var(--folder); color: var(--engraving); font: 13px/1.35 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-foot::before { content: ""; display: block; height: 7px; margin-bottom: 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--mark); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--mark); } .ds-debug { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 6px 0 0; color: var(--grey); font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch { position: relative; flex: none; width: 44px; height: 26px; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--edge); transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--grey); pointer-events: none; transition: transform 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-switch:has(:checked) { background: var(--lime); } .ds-switch:has(:checked)::after { background: var(--folder); transform: translateX(18px); } .ds-switch:has(:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: inherit; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-switch, .ds-switch::after { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
A reader's page in paper and ink. Whatever a site demands of the reader shows up as a key nobody presses: a pale, dashed outline at display size, drawn but inert. Tacet's own voice speaks only from ink panels with lime type, and one lime highlighter marks the answer. Everything else is quiet: warm off-white paper, olive-black ink, hairline rules, generous 17px/1.7 reading text, no shadows, no imagery beyond the mark.

The world is inherited, not invented. It belongs to the sg-x family (the user's sibling extension, sg-x/docs/styles.css), chosen explicitly as "same family as sg-x". The shared family layer is identical value for value: paper, ink, muted, line, green, lime, tint, the selection colour, the system UI stack, the 1120px content and 720px reading widths, the section rhythm, header, footer, links, buttons, Read-page layouts and disclosures. Tacet adds four tokens and the devices built on them: the unpressed key colours (text and dashed line), the ink-panel rule and muted tokens, the switch, the readout, the ruled register, the lime highlighter under the answer, and the wash motion. Tacet extends the family without retuning any of its values.

Two things sit in the repository but outside this world. The made-up newspaper inside the homepage demo (docs/demo/demo.css, en.html, fr.html) imitates a generic news site on purpose, with a white ground, Georgia serif, a drop-shadowed consent box and uppercase tracked datelines. It is a contained exception that lives only inside the demo frame. The extension's toolbar popup (src/popup/) has its own dark world, documented in its own section, The Toolbar Popup, at the end of this file.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground (#f6f5ef) everywhere; depth comes from tone (tint card, ink panel), never from shadow.
One type family at weights 400 to 750; display character comes from weight 750 and tracking down to -0.045em.
Hairline-ruled structure: sections, lists, the register and disclosures are separated by 1px rules, not boxes.
Unpressed keys: the site's demands rendered as dashed, inert outlines at display size.
Ink panels with lime type are where Tacet itself speaks.
One motion grammar: a status changes in place under a brief lime wash.
Every string exists in English and French; layouts are sized for the longer French.

rules.name: The Family Rule
rules.body: The family tokens are sg-x's, value for value. Tacet adds tokens next to them and never retunes one.

rules.name: The Lime Has Two Places Rule
rules.body: Lime is type and marks on ink, where Tacet speaks, and a highlighter underline on paper, once per page. It is never text on paper and never the fill of a button or card. Its only other appearance is the transient wash.

rules.name: The Unpressed Rule
rules.body: The two unpressed colours belong only to keys nobody presses. Faded Key Olive holds 3.2:1, so it never appears below display size.

rules.name: The Folded Question Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow, kicker or small label above a heading. When a section has a question to ask, the question goes into the heading itself, as the homepage folds "Accept all / Refuse" into its h1.

rules.name: The Ledger Figures Rule
rules.body: Every figure that changes or is compared uses tabular numerals. This covers register times, change counts and readout timings.

rules.name: The French Runs Longer Rule
rules.body: Sizes are set so the French fits rather than trimmed to the English. The French headline is smaller (min(100px, 6.9vw)), and below 480px French keys shrink to min(1em, 10.5vw) so "Tout accepter" stays one key while the answer keeps its size.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the site floats. If something needs more weight, it moves from paper to tint, or from tint to an ink panel.

rules.name: The One Motion Rule
rules.body: A status changes in place under a brief lime wash: the background goes from rgb(213 237 117 / 22%) to transparent over 900ms on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). New readout entries and turning register rows use it, and nothing else animates apart from the switch's own knob. Under prefers-reduced-motion the wash, the switch transitions and smooth anchor scrolling are all off, and the register shows its final state from the start.

rules.name: The Live Lime Rule
rules.body: In the popup, lime means "live now". It appears only on a switch that is on, the rest while Tacet acts or watches, and focus. It is never decoration, never text and never a button fill.

rules.name: The Two Greys Rule
rules.body: Folder Grey (#8f9288) is for words and Rest Grey (#7d8076) is for marks. Secondary text never drops to Rest Grey.

rules.name: The Engraved Figure Rule
rules.body: Tacet Figures sets the count above the rest and nothing else. Every other figure in the popup is system UI in tabular numerals.

dos: Do keep paper (#f6f5ef) as the only page ground, and give Tacet's own voice an ink (#20231d) panel with 12px corners and lime type.
Do divide sections with a 1px Pencil Hairline (#d5d8ca) and clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px) of space, not with background bands or boxes.
Do draw any question the site puts to the reader as unpressed keys (3px dashed #b9bdaa, 2px under 650px, text #868b73, 0.17em corners), only at display size.
Do mark at most one answer per page with the lime highlighter: an underline 0.3em thick at -0.2em offset, skip-ink off.
Do set every changing or compared figure in tabular numerals.
Do announce every demo change in the readout (role="status") and keep it reversible by the same switch.
Do change a status in place under the 900ms lime wash, and turn it off under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do write every string in English and French, and size headlines and keys for the French.
Do keep touch targets at 44px minimum and buttons and the switch at 48px.
Do focus with a 3px Olive Mark (#526600) outline at 4px offset; inside ink panels, lime.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow, kicker or small label above a heading; fold the question into the heading.
Don't make an unpressed key clickable, hoverable or focusable, and don't style a real control with a dashed outline.
Don't set lime as text on paper, or use it to fill buttons or cards.
Don't add other motion: no fades, slides, scroll reveals, parallax or animated counters.
Don't use drop shadows or gradients for depth; move from paper to tint to ink instead.
Don't retune a family token (paper, ink, muted, line, green, lime, tint); add a named token beside it instead.
Don't show site or consent-tool logos; their names stay plain text.
Don't carry the demo newspaper's styles (Georgia serif, white ground, shadowed box, uppercase tracked datelines) out of the demo frame.

popup.overview:
The popup is an instrument's part on a black stand folder. What Tacet silenced on this page is counted the way engraved music counts silence: a multi-measure rest with its figure above it. Engraving white sits on folder black, hairlines run like staff lines, and lime marks only what is live. The page closes on a final double bar, and the debug row sits quietly below it. It is dense and small, a 340px instrument read in two seconds, not a reading page.

The popup is dark only, by the user's choice. It has no light mode and does not follow the system's colour scheme (color-scheme: dark, fixed).
keyCharacteristics: Folder black (#141513) ground, engraving white (#ecebe5) text; dark only, never matched to the system.
Lime only for live state: switches on, the rest when Tacet acted or watches, focus.
The count is a multi-measure rest with a Tacet Figures numeral above it.
Hairline rows (#262824) like staff lines; the foot closes on a final double bar.
One motion: switch thumbs, track colours and the selected segment over 180ms ease-out.
dos: Do keep the popup dark only: folder black (#141513) ground, engraving white (#ecebe5) text, color-scheme: dark.
Do keep lime (#d5ed75) for live state only: a switch on, the rest while Tacet acts or watches, focus.
Do count what Tacet silenced as the rest with its Tacet Figures numeral, and change its state in place by colour and fill.
Do set secondary text in Folder Grey (#8f9288) and keep Rest Grey (#7d8076) for marks, disabled text and the double bar.
Do put each switch on the right of a 44px row whose whole width toggles it.
Do rule rows with 1px Staff Hairlines (#262824) and close the page on the final double bar.
Do keep monospace for selectors and tabular numerals for times and row numbers.
Do move only switch thumbs, track colours and the selected segment, over 180ms ease-out, and nothing under reduced motion.
Do ship every font inside the package; the popup makes no network requests.
donts: Don't add a light theme or follow the system's colour scheme.
Don't use lime as text, as a button fill or as decoration.
Don't carry the website's paper, ink, unpressed keys or wash into the popup, or the popup's folder palette onto the site.
Don't set any figure other than the count in Tacet Figures, or any text other than selectors in monospace.
Don't add a power button, a "blocked" badge or icons to buttons.
Don't add shadows for depth; step from folder to Raised Folder to Selected Folder instead.
